items.title_en: New York brewery owner claims security camera captured ghost in kitchen
items.title_zh: 纽约啤酒厂老板声称安全摄像头在厨房拍到了鬼魂
items.summary_en: The owner of a New York brewery has shared security footage he believes could show something paranormal in his kitchen.
items.summary_zh: 纽约一家啤酒厂的老板分享了他认为厨房里可能出现超自然现象的监控录像。

items.title_en: Top 10 Startups in 2026: Zepto retains top spot for 4th consecutive year
items.title_zh: 2026 年 10 强初创公司：Zepto 连续 4 年蝉联榜首
items.summary_en: Zepto ranked No. 1 in the top 10 list for startups in 2026, released by LinkedIn.
items.summary_zh: 在 LinkedIn 发布的 2026 年初创公司 10 强榜单中，Zepto 排名第一。

items.title_en: German woman, 99, walks on the wing of a moving plane, creates world record: ‘I was so excited’
items.title_zh: 德国99岁老妇在移动的飞机机翼上行走创造世界纪录：“我太兴奋了”
items.summary_en: Defying age and gravity, 99-year-old Helga Duffy takes to the open skies to become the world’s oldest female wing walker.
items.summary_zh: 99 岁的赫尔加·达菲 (Helga Duffy) 不畏年龄和地心引力，飞向开阔的天空，成为世界上最年长的女性翼行者。

items.title_en: US man failed to get a pilot’s license, now he flies to work: ‘I do it for fun’
items.title_zh: 美国男子未能获得飞行员执照，现在他飞去上班：“我这样做是为了好玩”
items.summary_en: A childhood passion for aviation led one US commuter to swap his highway drive for a daily flight, turning a routine trip to work into a sky-high hobby.
items.summary_zh: 童年时期对航空的热情促使一位美国通勤者放弃了高速公路驾驶，转而乘坐每日航班，将例行的上班旅行变成了一种极高的爱好。

items.title_en: Hibaldstow man jailed for sex with dead woman
items.title_zh: 希伯斯托男子因与死去的女人发生性关系而入狱
items.summary_en: Stephen Sellars, 62, was interrupted by the woman's son and nephew, a court hears.
items.summary_zh: 法庭获悉，62 岁的斯蒂芬·塞拉斯 (Stephen Sellars) 被该女子的儿子和侄子打断。

items.title_en: Deer are all over New Jersey roads looking for sex, state officials warn
items.title_zh: 新泽西州官员警告说，鹿遍布新泽西州道路寻找性行为
items.summary_en: Mid-October through mid-December is deer mating season, which can be a danger to drivers as the sex-seeking creatures cross roadways throughout the Garden State.
items.summary_zh: 十月中旬到十二月中旬是鹿的交配季节，这对司机来说可能是一个危险，因为这些寻求性的动物穿过整个花园州的道路。

items.title_en: Archaeologists In Turkey Believe They Just Found The World’s Oldest Shipwreck
items.title_zh: 土耳其考古学家相信他们刚刚发现了世界上最古老的沉船
items.summary_en: Hakan Öniz Researchers off the coast of Kekova Island in Antalya discovered artifacts from a shipwreck that dates back as far as 4,700 years. An ancient cargo vessel believed to be the world’s oldest shipwreck has been found off the coast of Turkey. This sunken ship dates back an astonishing 4,700 years — right around the time when the pyramids of Egypt were being built just across the Mediterranean Sea.
